references.text: Moses repeats the promise that the Lord will send hornets to drive out the peoples hiding from the Israelites.
Joshua refers to the fulfillment of the promise about the hornets that drove out the two Amorite kings before Israel.
Earlier in the same chapter, the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites are mentioned as peoples the Lord will destroy.
The Lord promises to send an angel ahead of the people and drive out the Canaanites, Hittites, and Hivites.
The Lord repeats the promise to drive out nations including the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites.
The list of seven nations to be driven out, including the Hittites, Canaanites, and Hivites.
In the covenant with Abraham, several of the same peoples are mentioned, including the Hittites and Canaanites, who will lose their land.
